[03-06 Dec 2026 / All sessions at TBarM]{.eyebrow}

Sixteen hour-long slots across two days, everyone in the same room. Sessions run 50 minutes (about 25 minutes of hands-on demonstration, 15 of what-and-why, and 10 of audience input) with a 10-minute turnover. Click any session for the full description and the presenter's bio, or browse them all on the [sessions page](sessions/index.qmd).

::: {.day-block}
[Thursday, 03 Dec]{.day-date}

### Arrival

Check in at TBarM through the afternoon. The workshop opens with dinner, introductions, and an informal meet-and-greet afterward.
:::

::: {.day-block}
